capabilities: Remove extra blank lines with Backspace
Join lines with Delete or Backspace
Preserve default key behavior with Shift
Skip lists, quotes, callouts, code, math and tables
disambiguation: Not a line-wrapping or hard-wrap tool; it changes Enter and Backspace behavior around Markdown blocks.
motivation: The author was annoyed by having to repeatedly press Enter and Backspace to keep Markdown tidy.
problem: Keeping Markdown paragraph spacing and trailing spaces tidy requires repeated Enter and Backspace presses.
summary: Keyboard behavior plugin that changes Enter, Shift+Enter, Backspace and Delete to manage blank lines and trailing spaces around Markdown blocks.
